article.hook: You watch someone wrap a gift with extra care, even when the tape wrinkles. The Sun moves into Cancer and suddenly, what feels private wants a quiet shield. This is a month where what you protect says who you are.
article.lived: For about four weeks, our days fill with small defenses - correcting the way a story was told, holding back a text until the right moment, setting a table with familiar dishes. We build fences around our time and feelings, sometimes by saying no before we say yes. The world’s noise dims when we focus on the people and things that carry our history and hope.
article.turn: The problem starts when guarding becomes locking down. When you care so much you stop sharing, or when loyalty turns into a silent grudge against anyone who crosses the line you drew. You don’t protect tenderness by hiding it; you trap it where no one can help.
moves: Offer a quiet compliment to someone who usually holds back.
Put one photo or object that reminds you of home where you can see it every day.
Say what you need before you get defensive about it.
